tasks.title: Floating Wind Turbines
paras: Wind turbines are large devices with long blades that capture wind energy and convert it into electricity. Floating wind turbines are a special type of wind turbines because they are not fixed to the seabed but are anchored using advanced mooring systems, allowing placement in deeper waters where winds are more consistent. In this context, anchoring refers to securing the turbine in place using cables or chains connected to weighted structures or anchors on the ocean floor, ensuring stability despite the lack of a fixed foundation. The deeper placement means the wind turbines can harness untapped wind resources that traditional turbines cannot access.

Engineering floating turbines involves unique challenges. They rely on buoyancy principles rather than on solid ground, making their design and maintenance complex. Despite the increased costs, their ability to reduce visual and noise pollution makes them an attractive option for distant offshore locations. However, their long-term viability is threatened by harsh marine conditions that can accelerate wear and tear.

(A)Research continues to explore solutions for these problems. (B)Some experts are investigating materials and designs to enhance durability. (C)As efforts to capitalize on deeper offshore wind resources persist, floating turbines represent both a promising opportunity and a complex engineering puzzle.(D)

questions.stem: The word "harness" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 解析： "harness untapped wind resources"意为"利用未开发的风能资源"。harness在此表示"利用、开发"。 选项分析： A. limit（限制）：相反含义。 B. distribute（分配）：不符。 C. release（释放）：不符。D. exploit（开发利用）：意思最接近。

questions.stem: What unique advantage do floating wind turbines have over traditional turbines?

options.A: They are larger in size and have longer blades.
options.C: They can be placed in deeper waters.

questions.analysis: 解析： 文中明确说明："allowing placement in deeper waters where winds are more consistent"（允许放置在更深的水域，那里风力更稳定），且"deeper placement means the wind turbines can harness untapped wind resources that traditional turbines cannot access"（传统涡轮机无法进入）。 选项分析： A. 尺寸更大叶片更长：文中未比较尺寸。 B. 需要更少维护：文中说"design and maintenance complex"（维护复杂）。 D. 更容易设计：文中说设计复杂，不是更容易。

questions.stem: Why does the author mention "buoyancy principles"?

options.A: To point out a challenge of creating floating turbines
options.B: To suggest a new area for future research into floating turbines
options.C: To emphasize the greater flexibility of floating turbines compared with traditional turbines
options.D: To provide an example of cost-saving measures related to floating turbines

questions.analysis: 解析： 文中提到："They rely on buoyancy principles rather than on solid ground, making their design and maintenance complex"（依靠浮力原理而非固体地面，使设计和维护变得复杂）。这说明浮力原理带来了工程挑战。 选项分析： B. 建议未来研究新领域：不是建议新领域，而是说明现有挑战。 C. 强调灵活性：未提及灵活性。 D. 提供节省成本的例子：文中说"increased costs"（成本增加），不是节省成本。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the acceleration of "wear and tear" in floating turbines?

options.A: Any attempts to reduce it will likely prove to be unsuccessful.
options.B: Scientists are working to control it through better designs and materials.
options.C: It is prompting engineers to place floating wind turbines closer to shore.
options.D: It makes floating turbines especially unattractive to look at.

questions.analysis: 解析： 文中提到磨损加速的问题后，紧接着说"Research continues to explore solutions for these problems. Some experts are investigating materials and designs to enhance durability"（研究继续探索解决方案，一些专家正在研究材料和设计以提高耐久性）。 选项分析： A. 任何减少磨损的尝试都可能失败：与文中积极探索解决方案矛盾。 C. 促使工程师将涡轮机靠近海岸放置：文中未提及。 D. 使浮动涡轮机看起来特别不美观：文中说"reduce visual...pollution"（减少视觉污染），即视觉上是有吸引力的。

questions.stem: There are four locations (A, B, C, and D) in the passage that indicate where the following sentence could be added. "Others assess economic models that might offset higher initial expenses." Where would the sentence best fit? Select a location where the sentence could be added to the passage.
questions.analysis: 解析： 待插入句中的"Others"（其他人）表明前文应有"Some..."（一些人）的结构，形成"Some... Others..."的并列对比。 原文第3段："(A)Research continues to explore solutions for these problems. (B)Some experts are investigating materials and designs to enhance durability. (C)As efforts to capitalize on deeper offshore wind resources persist, floating turbines represent both a promising opportunity and a complex engineering puzzle.(D) " 选项分析： 正确位置应在"Some experts are investigating..."之后，用"Others assess..."形成对比，说明不同专家从不同角度解决问题：一些人研究材料和设计，另一些人评估经济模型。
